structure.note: Weighted voting rights: each Class A share has 10 votes and each Class B share one vote, except on a limited number of Reserved Matters where every share has one vote. The report says 'The Company is controlled through weighted voting rights.' The WVR beneficiaries are Lei Jun (4,068,513,104 Class A shares, about 61.9% of votes on ordinary matters) and co-founder Lin Bin (448,997,030 Class A shares, about 6.8%). All Class A shares together equal 18.0% of issued share capital excluding treasury shares. Lei Jun's shares are held through trusts he settled for the benefit of himself and his family (ARK Trust (Hong Kong) Limited as trustee).
